# core:update-project-metadata

## Rules
- Hash SHA-256 of project `specd.yaml` + all config `contextFiles`.
- For every spec in project context: `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` default `if-needed`; record `metadataFingerprint` in `freshness`. MUST NOT hash raw metadata-cache file or repo storage revision.
- `project-metadata.json` update SHALL be atomic.
- Caller supplies only `optimizedContext` string (wrapped in input object). MUST NOT accept caller freshness hashes or versioning. Maps to internal `optimized.context`.
- Config factory via `resolveUpdateProjectMetadataDeps`: `config`, `listWorkspaces`, `specRepos`, `getMetadata`, `files`, `fileWriter`, `hasher`. MUST NOT reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.

## Constraints
- None beyond rules above.
